programme.title: Highlights - 2026 Youth Olympic Games – Dakar
programme.desc: The Dakar 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games take place from 31 October to 13 November 2026 in Senegal. The Dakar 2026 Summer Youth Olympic Games will be the first-ever Olympic event hosted in Africa.

programme.title: Washington vs Detroit - NBA Season - 2026
programme.desc: The 2026–27 NBA season is the 81st season of the National Basketball Association. The current NBA champions are the New York Knicks. The regular season runs from October 20, 2026, to April 11, 2027.

programme.title: EN ATP Tour: This Week 2026 Ep.44
programme.desc: The official source for the latest news from the ATP Tour and the world of men's professional tennis.

programme.title: EN Fast Zone 2026
programme.desc: Your weekly motor/racing update - distilled into one half-hour programme. Covering everything from prototypes to endurance racing, karting to airplanes and even some real oddities… With both tradition and a fresh take on motorsport, Fast/Zone is the ultimate resource for everything that's fast and fascinating!

programme.title: Ipswich Town vs Bournemouth - English Premier League 2026/2027 - Week 10
programme.desc: Ipswich won their last league game against Bournemouth but haven’t won consecutive games against the Cherries since a run of four between January 1953 and October 1955. Bournemouth haven’t lost any of their four league visits to Portman Road against Ipswich since a 3-1 defeat in March 1989 under Harry Redknapp.
